charts.title: Browser share
charts.note: One slice per row, its angle proportional to the value. innerRadius turns the pie into a donut; label writes the percentage outside each slice. Clicking a legend item hides that slice (interaction.legend-filter) and the rest recompute their share against the smaller total automatically — mark.arc always divides by the total of only the visible rows, so hiding is not a separate feature, just a consequence of how the angles are computed. Double-click a legend item to isolate it.
